TitleShowStubBlobs: Show Stub Blobs for Virtual Directories
DescriptionDefaultListMode: The default list mode to use when opening a blob explorer. This setting only applies to non-ADLS Gen2 blob explorers. If set to hierarchical, blob names delimited by '/' will be parsed into virtual directories, forming a hierarchical view. If set to flat, blobs will be listed by their full name without virtual directories. List mode can also be changed on a per-container basis via the view options panel in the blob explorer.
DescriptionOpenViewOptionsByDefault: If enabled, the view options panel will be shown automatically when a blob explorer is opened.
DescriptionShowStubBlobs: If enabled, blob explorers will show stub blobs. Stub blobs are blobs which have the metadata 'hdi_isFolder=true'. Stub blobs are created and used by other services as representations of directories. When performing an operation on a stub blob, such as delete, the operation will also be performed on blobs in the directory the stub blob represents.
